end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Aditya gave 4 unaided correct responses out of 7 attempts.
Described a cylinder as having two flat circular faces and a curved side.
Initially thought turning an upside-down cone changed its shape name; this was corrected later.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying 3D shapes through familiar toys and used face-and-surface clues for the cylinder and cone. Aditya explained that a cylinder has two flat circular faces and later corrected the mix-up about an upside-down cone: turning it does not change its name. At home, turn a ball, cone, and box in different ways and ask Aditya to name each shape after it is moved.
